summary: Product-scoped record for Flipster Earn. First-party Flipster material verifies an Earn Campaign beginning on 3 April 2024, while current 2026 documentation shows Premium Earn and other Earn variants continuing under product-specific terms.
what_happened: Flipster's reviewed Earn Campaign FAQ states that the campaign began on 3 April 2024 at 00:00 UTC and paid variable daily rewards based on eligible USDT wallet balances. Current Premium Earn documentation shows an evolved Earn product in which allocated USDT can earn a floating APR while remaining usable as margin for certain perpetual-futures trading. Premium Earn terms impose a 24-hour lockup after a withdrawal request and reserve rights to restrict or suspend redemption in specified compliance, security, legal or force-majeure circumstances. CYA treats Premium Earn, Dynamic Earn and earlier campaign mechanics as product-specific variants within the Flipster Earn lineage rather than inventing one universal yield-source, custody or redemption model.
uncertainty_notes: The 3 April 2024 date is the verified start of the reviewed Flipster Earn Campaign. It is not asserted to prove that no earlier Flipster yield or reward feature existed. Current Premium Earn and other Earn variants have distinct terms, reward sources and risk mechanics.
notes: The broader Flipster exchange, derivatives platform and non-Earn campaigns are outside this product identity. Current Premium Earn terms, rather than older promotional descriptions, govern the reviewed risk interpretation for that variant.

summary: Product-scoped record for Bitrue Power Piggy. Multiple first-party Bitrue materials describe the flexible investment/staking service as launched in early 2019, and 2026 materials confirm continuing operation across a large set of supported assets. An exact launch day is not inferred.
what_happened: Bitrue describes Power Piggy as its long-running flexible investment and staking product and states in multiple first-party materials that it launched in early 2019. Reviewed product guides describe daily rewards and flexible redemption for standard Power Piggy positions, while separate BTR-linked and lockup products can use different caps, boost mechanics and holding periods. Bitrue's December 2025 outlook states that Power Piggy remained a core product entering 2026, and March 2026 material documents a live XRP flexible-staking pool with no lockup. CYA leaves launch_date null because the reviewed sources establish only early-2019 precision and do not support an exact day.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed first-party sources establish that Power Piggy launched in early 2019 but do not establish the exact launch date, so launch_date remains null. Asset eligibility, APR, caps, BTR boosts, flexible redemption and lockup mechanics vary by product and period.
notes: Bitrue Launchpool, liquidity mining and other investment products are outside this product identity unless separately reviewed. Product marketing and APR campaigns are not treated as a principal, custody or solvency guarantee.
